name: Natural Earth
author: Natural Earth contributors
note: 1:10m Admin 0 map subunits, Admin 1 states and provinces (including the version without large lakes), lakes, Admin 0 disputed areas, land and disputed-area boundary lines, and minor islands, versions 4.1–5.1.1. Used for both world maps and the maps of Japan, Australia, Canada, China (including Taiwan), France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States, South Korea, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, Portugal, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Malaysia, Thailand, India, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Czechia, Croatia, Greece, Hungary, Chile, Colombia, Türkiye, the United Arab Emirates, Sri Lanka, New Zealand and South Africa; for the coastlines of Norway, Finland and Peru and for Åland; for lakes in Indonesia, the Philippines, Finland and Peru; and for the disputed areas and lines. Reprojected, merged and simplified for this app.

name: Indonesia regency boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by BPS – Statistics Indonesia, the World Food Programme and OCHA ROAP
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen IDN ADM2 (2020 boundaries). Regencies were merged into Indonesia's 38 provinces, including Kalimantan Utara and the Papua provinces created in 2022, then reprojected and simplified. Citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Philippines province and municipality boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by NAMRIA, the Philippine Statistics Authority and OCHA Philippines
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen PHL ADM2 and ADM3 (2020 boundaries). The Metro Manila districts were merged into one region and Maguindanao was divided into Maguindanao del Norte and Maguindanao del Sur (Republic Act 11550) using municipal boundaries; reprojected and simplified. Citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Norway county boundaries
author: © Kartverket (Norwegian Mapping Authority)
note: Administrative enheter – fylker, downloaded from Geonorge: the 15 counties in force since 1 January 2024. Clipped to the Natural Earth coastline, reprojected and simplified.

name: Taiwan municipality, county and city boundaries
author: National Land Surveying and Mapping Center, Ministry of the Interior (Taiwan)
note: 直轄市、縣市界線 (TWD97), version 1140318, covering all 22 municipalities, counties and cities, including Kinmen and Lienchiang (Matsu). Reprojected and simplified; some remote islets omitted.

name: Finland region boundaries
author: Statistics Finland (Tilastokeskus)
note: Regions 2026 (Maakunnat 2026, 1:1 000 000) from Statistics Finland's statistical areas interface service: the 18 mainland regions as they have been since the 2021 changes. They were fitted to the Natural Earth coastline and lakes; Åland comes from Natural Earth. Reprojected and simplified. Source: Statistics Finland.

name: Peru province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN) and OCHA ROLAC
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen PER ADM2 (2020 boundaries). The 196 provinces were grouped into Peru's regions, with Lima Province and Callao on their own, then fitted to the Natural Earth coastline, reprojected and simplified. Citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Colombia municipality boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by DANE (Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística)
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen COL ADM2 (2020 boundaries), used for the islands of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina. Reprojected and simplified. Citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Estonia county boundaries
author: Maa- ja Ruumiamet (Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board)
note: Haldus- ja asustusjaotus: Maa- ja Ruumiamet 02.09.2026. Municipalities merged into the 15 counties as drawn since 2017, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Estonia.

name: Kenya county boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by RCMRD
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen KEN ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Kenya. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Nepal province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the Survey Department of Nepal and OCHA
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen NPL ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Nepal. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Romania county boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the World Bank
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen ROU ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Romania. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Bulgaria province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by UNICEF
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian BGR ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Bulgaria. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Ukraine oblast boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by Kartographia
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian UKR ADM1; Crimea and Sevastopol from Natural Earth. Clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Ukraine. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Egypt governorate boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by CAPMAS
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian EGY ADM1 and gbOpen EGY ADM2, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Egypt. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Mongolia province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the National Statistical Office of Mongolia
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian MNG ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Mongolia. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: World Bank Official Boundaries
author: © The World Bank
note: Global Administrative Divisions, Admin 1, version 3 (10 September 2026). Used for Ecuador and Saudi Arabia, and for one internal border each in Iceland and Cuba, clipped to Natural Earth's country outlines. Also used for Jordan, Oman, Kuwait and Iran. Also used for the regions of Venezuela, Paraguay, Guatemala, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Honduras, El Salvador, Nigeria, Tanzania, Ghana, Senegal, Rwanda, Namibia, Tunisia and Algeria. Also used for Serbia, Albania, Armenia, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, and (Admin 2) Malta's local councils and coastline.

name: Iraq governorate boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the Central Statistical Organization of Iraq
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian IRQ ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Iraq. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. Halabja's border with Sulaymaniyah follows the IRQ ADM3 sub-districts.

name: Cambodia province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by Cambodia's national agencies via OCHA
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian KHM ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Cambodia. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Laos province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by Laos's national agencies via OCHA
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian LAO ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Laos. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Bangladesh division boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian BGD ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Bangladesh. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Bhutan district boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by OCHA
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian BTN ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Bhutan. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Papua New Guinea province boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the PNG National Statistical Office
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian PNG ADM1 (from HDX COD-AB), clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Papua New Guinea. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Qatar municipality boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data from the Qatar Open Data Portal
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen QAT ADM1, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Qatar. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Bahrain governorate boundaries
author: Who's On First; geometry from the US Department of State Humanitarian Information Unit
note: whosonfirst-data-admin-bh regions, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Bahrain.

name: Panama province and comarca boundaries
author: OCHA / HDX COD-AB Panama v01; original data by INEC (2020 boundaries)
note: Provinces and comarcas, clipped to Natural Earth's outline of Panama. Naso Tjër Di is approximated by its Teribe core, as no official shape exists yet.

name: Algeria commune boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by UNHCR via HDX
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian DZA ADM2, used to cut the ten 2019 wilayas from their parents. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. Also used for the eleven wilayas created in 2026 (Law 26-06, Decree 26-206), each the union of its communes.

name: Bosnia and Herzegovina canton boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab)
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen BIH ADM2, dissolved into cantons and entities. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Latvia municipality boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data from the Geoportal of Latvia (VZD)
note: geoBoundaries gbOpen LVA ADM1 (2021 boundaries). Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Kyrgyzstan region boundaries
author: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); original data by the Ministry of Emergency Situations of Kyrgyzstan via OCHA
note: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian KGZ ADM1. Cite: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.

name: Luxembourg canton boundaries
author: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT), Luxembourg
note: Cantons, 5 October 2026.

name: GeoNames
author: GeoNames
note: Settlement points used, with Wikidata (CC0), to approximate Montenegro's four newest municipalities (Gusinje, Petnjica, Tuzi, Zeta).
